shortcuts.wayland: Keyboard shortcuts are not available on Wayland: an app can't listen to the keys while osu! has the focus.
shortcuts.off: Turn on keyboard shortcuts in the settings (Trainer) to run a preset on the map selected in osu! while you play.
shortcuts.how: Click a preset's field and press its keys: Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Super with another key, or a function key (F1 to F24), so osu! keeps its own. Backspace takes it away, Escape leaves the field. It runs on the map selected in osu!, with its own HP, OD and AR.
shortcuts.active: Working: press it while osu! has the focus
shortcuts.failedTitle: The system did not give it: another app may have it
shortcuts.taking: Taking keys: the shortcuts are off until you leave the field.
shortcuts.failed: The system did not give this shortcut: another app may have it. Try other keys.
shortcuts.gameKey: {{ keys }} alone is a key of the game: add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Super.
shortcuts.running: The last convert is still running.
shortcuts.cantRead: Can't read the map selected in osu!.
shortcuts.noTasks: None of the tasks of "{{ name }}" work on this map's mode.

trainer.noTasksForMode: None of the converts' tasks work on this map's mode.

trainer.onlyFor: Only for {{ modes }} maps: skipped on this one

rate.noFfmpeg: Scaling the video needs ffmpeg, which was not found. Install it and make sure it is in the PATH, then restart the app.
rate.videoSlow: The video is re-encoded at the new speed, which can take a while for long videos.
rate.storyboard: If the set has a shared .osb storyboard, it is used by every difficulty, so this difficulty will be exported to a new beatmap set (title ending in ({{ rate }}x SB)) to avoid overlapping with the original one.

sv.description: The original SV changes are removed and an SV is set on every BPM change, so the scroll speed stays the one of the main BPM. BPM changes, kiai and hitsounds are kept.

fln.description: Turns every note into a long note held until just before the next note in its column.
fln.gapHint: How early each long note ends before the next note in the column.
fln.minLengthHint: Long notes that would be shorter than this stay as normal notes.
fln.rework: Also reshape the map's existing long notes

noteLength.approx: (1/{{ divisor }} beat ≈ {{ ms }} ms at {{ bpm }} BPM)

keys.description: Moves the notes to another number of keys. Streams roll over the new keys, while real trills, jacks and chords keep their shape.
keys.reducing: Chords shrink with the key count (on 7K to 4K, 3 or 4 notes become 2) and notes are dropped rather than turned into jacks.

density.noneHint: Only the notes of the original map.
density.denseHint: Adds a note on the beats and chords: next to the chord up to 7K, where its hand is going on 8K and more.
density.moreDenseHint: Adds notes on almost every row: next to the chord up to 7K, where its hand is going on 8K and more, mostly in the denser parts.
density.fullHint: Chords grow with the key count, like hand-made conversions: jumps become hands and hands become quints. Handstreams stay handstreams, and the map gets much harder.

keys.keepJacks: Keep the map's jacks on a single key

playstyles.3_2+1: Two keys on the left hand, one on the right.
playstyles.5_3+2: Middle key with the left index.
playstyles.8_3+2+3: Both thumbs on the middle keys.
playstyles.8_1+7: 7K with a scratch on the left, IIDX style.
playstyles.12_12K: Every key is a lane: the patterns run into the outer keys.
playstyles.12_10K2S: A 10K map with a scratch on each side for the hard hits of the music, hit by moving a pinky outward. The density also sets how many.
playstyles.14_DP: Double Play, IIDX style: 7 keys per hand in two rows.
playstyles.14_EZ2AC: 10K and 4 middle keys either hand moves to (Space Mix).
playstyles.16_DP: Double Play with a scratch on each side (14K2S).
playstyles.16_EZ2AC: 10K2S and 4 middle keys either hand moves to.
playstyles.18_10K8K: 10K and 4 more keys per hand for every finger but the thumb (4K10K4K).
playstyles.18_9K9K: 9 keys per hand in two rows, like a DP for pop'n music.

downloader.subtitle: Download beatmap sets directly to your Songs folder.
downloader.libraryHint: Load your osu! library to automatically skip maps you already own.

guide.howTo1: Get the osu_session cookie (see How to get the osu! session).
guide.howTo2: Paste it in the cookie field.
guide.howTo3: Drop or select a .txt file with the download links (see File format).
guide.howTo4: The queue lists the IDs of the maps: click Start download.
guide.session: How to get the osu! session
guide.session2: Go to the osu! website and make sure you are logged in.
guide.session3: Right click and choose Inspect, or press F12.
guide.session4: Go to the Application or Storage tab.
guide.session5: Go to Cookies → https://osu.ppy.sh and copy the value of the cookie called osu_session.
guide.format1: A .txt file with one download link per line.
guide.settings1: Open the settings with the gear icon.
guide.settings2: Notify: shows a notification when the downloads finish.
guide.settings3: Error file: writes the failed downloads to a file in the output folder.
guide.settings4: Save cookie: keeps the osu_session cookie when Torosu closes; otherwise it only lasts for this session.
guide.settings5: Output folder: where the downloads are saved; without one, osu!'s Songs folder.
guide.settings6: Load library: loads the osu! library when you open the downloader, to skip the maps you already have.
guide.settings7: Skip video: doesn't download the videos, which saves bandwidth and disk space.
guide.settings8: Max concurrent downloads: how many download at once; 1 by default, raise it at your own risk.
